title: Sampling is as easy as learning the score: theory for diffusion models with minimal data assumptions
tldr_zh: L² score+Lipschitz score+二阶矩下 DDPM 以 Θ̃(L²d/ε²) 步 TV-ε 逼近任意非 log-concave 分布；确立 Girsanov 范式
tldr_en: With L2-accurate scores, DDPM samples any non-log-concave distribution in Θ̃(L²d/ε²) steps (TV); establishes the Girsanov path-KL analysis paradigm.
key_numbers: Iteration complexity N = Θ̃(L²d/ε²) with ε_score ≤ Õ(ε) (Sec. 3.1)
Bounded-support early stopping: N = Θ̃(d³R⁴(R∨√d)⁴/(ε_TV² ε_W2⁸)) (Cor. 3); W2 version Θ̃(d³R⁸(R∨√d)⁴/ε¹²) (Cor. 5)
CLD path-KL lower bound KL(Q‖P) ≥ dhT for Gaussian target, exact score (Thm 7)
